info.name: Azure Monitor Batch query metrics for multiple resources

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the target subscription.

params.name: starttime
params.description: The start time of the query in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: endtime
params.description: The end time of the query in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: interval
params.description: The interval (window size) of the query in ISO 8601 duration format.

params.name: metricnames
params.description: The names of the metrics (comma-separated) to retrieve.

params.name: metricNamespace
params.description: Metric namespace that contains the requested metric names.

params.name: aggregation
params.description: The list of aggregation types (comma-separated) to retrieve.

params.name: top
params.description: The maximum number of records to retrieve per resource.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The aggregation to use for sorting results and the direction of the sort.

params.name: $filter
params.description: The $filter used to reduce the set of metric data returned.

params.name: rollUpBy
params.description: Dimension name(s) to rollup results by.

items.docs: Lists the metric values for multiple resources in a single batch request. All resources must be in the same subscription, region, and resource type. Allows for efficient retrieval of metric data at scale.
